remarks: **Tucked-Away Gem in a Sought-After Community** Move right in and enjoy this charming townhouse offering comfort, style, and convenience. The inviting main level features a bright living/dining area with a fireplace, and sliders leading to a private deck or patio-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The updated eat-in kitchen includes stainless steel appliances and a tile floor. A half bath and laundry room complete this level.  Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms each feature en-suite baths and customized closets. Additional highlights include updated bathrooms, a newer washer and dryer, and abundant storage throughout. The home also offers a dedicated carport with locked storage plus an additional parking space. Set in a beautifully landscaped, well-maintained community close to trains, shops, schools, and restaurants-this townhouse combines easy living with an unbeatable location.
